statusDefinitions.PASSED: Executed and all assertions passed with sufficient evidence.
statusDefinitions.FAILED: Executed and at least one assertion failed.
statusDefinitions.SKIPPED: Intentionally skipped because a documented precondition or approved fixture was unavailable.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED: Could not execute because of an environment or external dependency blocker.
statusDefinitions.NOT_REPORTED: No verified execution result has been recorded.
statusDefinitions.XFAIL: Expected failure recorded for a known product gap.

limitations: Historical static metrics have not all been rerun against the canonical QA directory.
Pytest collection does not prove live test behavior.
Gateway readiness does not prove the complete API suite passed.
MOB-013 root cause is not determined.
Skipped and not-reported tests must not be counted as passed.
Audio player UI state alone does not prove audible output.
